sahneler.metin: Hurricane Andrew smashed into south Florida.
Tens of thousands of homes were destroyed in a single night.
Investigators studied why so many failed.
Many roofs were poorly nailed and weakly connected.
Broken windows let pressure build inside.
Building codes had not always been enforced.
Florida then created a stronger statewide building code.
